answer: In a cooperative game economy, agents earn credits for locating hidden ivory relics on a tundra map. The game server signs each discovery event with its relic ID and the ledge tile where it was found. Payouts are keyed to that event ID, so wallets submitting the same find split one fee. Claimants lock a bond before the hunt, and fabricated event logs lose it after replay verification. A Sybil operator can open many wallets, but each extra reward requires a distinct verified discovery.
